literal_meaning: ঘরের জিনিসপত্র ভাগ করে নেওয়া (household items division)
example_sentences_in_bangla: পারিবারিক সম্পত্তি ঘরা-ঘরি করে ভাগ করা হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: They settled the dispute by ghara-ghori.
The family property was divided by ghara-ghori.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali practices of dividing household goods amicably during separations or inheritance, reflecting rural family customs.
note: Often used in contexts of amicable settlements in everyday life.
